p.bio: I started sailing age 8 with my parents, progressed into GBR Team age 15 representing GB at the Cadet Wold championships. Won various national & european titles iin various dinghy and small keelboat classes. Moved Worked for North Sails UK as a sail maker and was my introduction into big boats. Winning Mumm30 national & european chapionships and bronze at the world championships. Moved into Exteme 40´s representing Oman Sail, winning the series in 2009. Also racing with Alinghi in the GC32. After this moving into offshore racing, breaking over 14 world speed records on MOD7'´s & 100 footer Scallywag & Comanche. Current holder of RORC Transatlantic monohull & multihull class. Also record for the fastest crossing of the transpacific.

c: PUERTO PORTALS 52 SUPER SERIES SAILING WEEK & TP52 20TH ANNIVERSARY INVITATIONAL
